verdict.rationale: Dynadot's docs confirm a documented API covering 120+ actions including DNS management (dynadot-docs-1), but no evidence explicitly confirms create/update/delete record-level operations, OpenAPI spec, or ACME-challenge use cases; the MCP docs only mention reviewing DNS records (read-only) rather than editing them (dynadot-docs-6, dynadot-docs-20), and openapi probes returned 404 (dynadot-probe-2). missing for 10: explicit DNS record CRUD examples, ACME/automation use-case documentation, and a discoverable OpenAPI/API reference confirming record-level operations.
